bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through text and token classification, placeholder prediction to measure Bias Rate (fill-in-the-blank demographic tokens), counterfactual demographic swapping to test model neutrality, and stereotype agreement prompting.

Evaluated through text classification, Bias Rate measurement via demographic placeholder prediction, counterfactual substitution in prompts, sentiment scoring disparities across racial groups, and explicit stereotype agreement tests.
